issue.title: Plain Task Split writes LINKED FROM after the moved children, outside the task_block_layout managed-link zone
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-on.7 (req-split) note #2 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; triaged by the bob-cli-on land agent.

Plain (non-requirement) Task Split still writes the new task's `🪢 **LINKED FROM:**` back-link *after* the moved children, at the end of the new block. Since bob-cli-on.3, `task_block_layout` defines the canonical zone order (Cancel Log, managed links, reqs, authored notes, drawers, logs). Requirement carries (`task_split/carry.rs`) already place the back-link in the managed-link zone through `insertion_offset(ChildKind::ManagedLink)` and the note's indent unit. Plain splits do not, so a fresh split produces a block that `bob task tidy` would immediately report as out of zone.

Evidence (master 2b626d01): `tests/fixtures/task_split/vectors.json` SP2 expects
`- [ ] #task Write the rollback runbook … ^write-rollback\n  - include pg_dump timing\n  - 🪢 **LINKED FROM:** [[#^upgrade]] (💬 mentions)\n`, with the LINKED FROM line after the authored note. SP17 and SP18 have the same shape.

Fix: route the plain-split back-link through `task_block_layout::insertion_offset(.., ChildKind::ManagedLink, ..)` and the note's indent unit, as the req-carry path does. Then update the SP1–SP31 expected bytes. Change bob-cli first, then re-copy `tests/fixtures/task_split/vectors.json` into the bob-plugins split twin (`256-task-split-plan.js` / `257-task-split-apply.js`) and align it. A byte change to split output is a contract change; mark the commit with `!`.

task_type_fields.impact: Low: cosmetic block-order drift. Fresh splits disagree with the canonical layout every other writer follows, and a later tidy has to move the back-link.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/task_split (plain split back-link placement); tests/fixtures/task_split/vectors.json SP2/SP17/SP18; bob-plugins 256/257 split twin
task_type_fields.repro: Read SP2 in tests/fixtures/task_split/vectors.json: the expected new block ends with '  - include pg_dump timing' followed by '  - 🪢 **LINKED FROM:** [[#^upgrade]] (💬 mentions)'. Run bob task tidy on a vault after such a split and the LINKED FROM child sits after an authored note (out-of-zone).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-on.7 found that plain splits still place the back-link at the block tail while requirement carries use the managed-link zone, so a fresh split produces a block tidy calls out of zone.
